required_evidence.source: AGENTS.md §1 (actual-run rule: §1.4 vm-target test / topology test chain, §1.5 frozen candidate) and docs/actual-run-evidence.md
required_evidence.description: Candidate-bound target run (syntax, check/diff, apply, spec verify, second apply changed=0, plus the failure paths the change touches) on a disposable vm-target/docker-target, with the sanitized summary committed as docs/evidence/<feature>/<date>-<tested-revision>.md. Required for any change to playbooks, specs, contracts, inventory handling or deploy orchestration; not-applicable, with the reason, for docs/skill-only changes or pure Go changes proven by native-tool tests. required_paths lists the paths whose change always needs it (pr-review-merge's gate refuses not-needed and issue-to-pr's gate refuses not-applicable for them); Spec changes (docs/verification/**), Go inventory handling and deploy orchestration are left to the reviewer: a spec edit that changes no command, Expected, target or variable contract needs no new run (docs/actual-run-evidence.md section 4), which no path glob can tell apart, and a pure Go change proven by native-tool tests is exempt.
